method.name: CMX Feature Rectify Module (FRM)
method.full_system: CMX: Cross-Modal Fusion for RGB-X Semantic Segmentation with Transformers

project_adaptation.name: cmx_frm
project_adaptation.scope: FRM communication component only; not the full CMX segmentation system
project_adaptation.channel_requirement: equal channels; current R18 Stage3 is 256/256
project_adaptation.dimensionality: CFP is 2D feature grid and OCT is 3D feature grid
project_adaptation.equal_grid_parity: when grids match and alignment_tokens=H*W, implementation must numerically match author FRM
project_adaptation.cross_dimensional_spatial_rule: flatten native grids; linearly resample both to one fixed shared token lattice; apply author-equivalent kernel-1 spatial MLP; resample directional source feature and spatial weight back to each destination native grid
project_adaptation.scientific_boundary: project adaptation of an author communication component; no claim of reproducing author SegFormer/decoder/system results

future_matched_A_plus_bridge.A: one CMX-FRM Stage3 communication host trained under the existing small-cohort finite policy
future_matched_A_plus_bridge.metrics: branch Macro-F1 plus probability metrics and participant-paired bootstrap
